data.title: Jobcenter invitation for 22 April 2026
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen invites Lea Muster to a meeting on 22 April 2026 at 08:15 about her current job situation. She should bring her CV.
data.explanation: The Jobcenter has invited you (Meldeaufforderung) to discuss your current professional situation with Ms Petzold in room 1.18. Bring your CV (Lebenslauf). If you miss the appointment without an important reason, your Bürgergeld will be reduced by 10 percent of the standard rate for one month. If you cannot attend, contact the Jobcenter before the date and explain your reason. The letter gives no objection instructions.
